local CX, CY = 73, 19
local function free(p)
  return p ~= nil and not p:IsWater() and not p:IsImpassable() and not p:IsCity()
    and p:GetUnitCount() == 0 and p:GetDistrictType() < 0
end
local function same(p, q)
  return p ~= nil and q ~= nil and p:GetX() == q:GetX() and p:GetY() == q:GetY()
end
local function dist(p, x, y) return Map.GetPlotDistance(p:GetX(), p:GetY(), x, y) end
local archer = nil
for _, v in Players[0]:GetUnits():Members() do
  if GameInfo.Units[v:GetType()].UnitType == "UNIT_ARCHER"
      and v:GetX() == CX and v:GetY() == CY then archer = v end
end
if archer == nil then print("ERR|no archer garrisoned in Gongju") return end
local function guarded(s, a)
  for _, v in Players[0]:GetUnits():Members() do
    if v:GetID() ~= archer:GetID()
        and GameInfo.Units[v:GetType()].FormationClass ~= "FORMATION_CLASS_CIVILIAN"
        and dist(s, v:GetX(), v:GetY()) <= 1 then return true end
  end
  return dist(s, a:GetX(), a:GetY()) <= 1
end
local P, A, S, W = nil, nil, nil, nil
for y = 22, 16, -1 do
  for x = 70, 76 do
    local p = Map.GetPlot(x, y)
    if P == nil and free(p) and dist(p, CX, CY) == 2 then
      for d1 = 0, 5 do
        local s = Map.GetAdjacentPlot(x, y, d1)
        if P == nil and free(s) and dist(s, CX, CY) == 1 then
          for ry = 17, 21 do
            for rx = 71, 75 do
              local a = Map.GetPlot(rx, ry)
              if P == nil and free(a) and not same(a, s) and dist(a, CX, CY) <= 2
                  and dist(a, x, y) <= 2 and dist(a, s:GetX(), s:GetY()) >= 2
                  and not guarded(s, a) then
                for d2 = 0, 5 do
                  local w = Map.GetAdjacentPlot(x, y, d2)
                  if P == nil and free(w) and not same(w, a) and not same(w, s)
                      and dist(w, s:GetX(), s:GetY()) >= 2 then
                    P, A, S, W = p, a, s, w
                  end
                end
              end
            end
          end
        end
      end
    end
  end
end
if P == nil then print("ERR|no attacker tile at distance 2 from Gongju admits the layout") return end
local att = UnitManager.InitUnit(63, "UNIT_WARRIOR", P:GetX(), P:GetY())
if att == nil then print("ERR|barbarian spawn failed") return end
att:SetDamage(35)
UnitManager.PlaceUnit(archer, A:GetX(), A:GetY())
UnitManager.RestoreMovement(archer)
local st = UnitManager.InitUnit(0, "UNIT_SETTLER", S:GetX(), S:GetY())
if st == nil then print("ERR|settler spawn failed") return end
UnitManager.RestoreMovement(st)
local ex = UnitManager.InitUnit(0, "UNIT_WARRIOR", W:GetX(), W:GetY())
if ex == nil then print("ERR|warrior spawn failed") return end
ex:SetDamage(80)
UnitManager.RestoreMovement(ex)
print("OK|layout|attacker " .. P:GetX() .. "," .. P:GetY() .. "|archer " .. A:GetX() .. ","
  .. A:GetY() .. "|civilian " .. S:GetX() .. "," .. S:GetY() .. "|expendable " .. W:GetX()
  .. "," .. W:GetY())

local CX, CY = 73, 19
local ax, ay, n = nil, nil, 0
for _, u in Players[63]:GetUnits():Members() do
  local p = Map.GetPlot(u:GetX(), u:GetY())
  if Map.GetPlotDistance(u:GetX(), u:GetY(), CX, CY) == 2
      and PlayersVisibility[0]:IsVisible(p:GetIndex()) then
    n = n + 1
    ax, ay = u:GetX(), u:GetY()
    print("OK|attacker|" .. ax .. "," .. ay .. "|hp " .. (u:GetMaxDamage() - u:GetDamage()))
  end
end
if n ~= 1 then print("ERR|expected one visible attacker at distance 2 from Gongju, found " .. n) return end
local na, on_city = 0, 0
for _, v in Players[0]:GetUnits():Members() do
  local info = GameInfo.Units[v:GetType()]
  if info.UnitType == "UNIT_ARCHER" and Map.GetPlotDistance(v:GetX(), v:GetY(), CX, CY) >= 1
      and Map.GetPlotDistance(v:GetX(), v:GetY(), CX, CY) <= 2 then
    na = na + 1
    if Map.GetPlotDistance(v:GetX(), v:GetY(), ax, ay) > 2 then
      print("ERR|archer beyond two tiles of the attacker")
    end
    print("OK|archer|" .. v:GetX() .. "," .. v:GetY())
  end
  if v:GetX() == CX and v:GetY() == CY and info.FormationClass == "FORMATION_CLASS_LAND_COMBAT" then
    on_city = on_city + 1
  end
end
if na ~= 1 then print("ERR|expected one archer within two tiles of Gongju, found " .. na) end
if on_city ~= 0 then print("ERR|a land combat unit still occupies Gongju's tile") end
local sx, sy, ns = nil, nil, 0
for _, v in Players[0]:GetUnits():Members() do
  if GameInfo.Units[v:GetType()].UnitType == "UNIT_SETTLER" then
    ns = ns + 1
    sx, sy = v:GetX(), v:GetY()
    print("OK|civilian|" .. sx .. "," .. sy)
  end
end
if ns ~= 1 then print("ERR|expected one settler, found " .. ns) return end
if Map.GetPlotDistance(sx, sy, ax, ay) ~= 1 then print("ERR|settler is not beside the attacker") end
if Map.GetPlotDistance(sx, sy, CX, CY) ~= 1 then print("ERR|settler is not beside Gongju") end
for _, v in Players[0]:GetUnits():Members() do
  local info = GameInfo.Units[v:GetType()]
  if info.FormationClass ~= "FORMATION_CLASS_CIVILIAN"
      and Map.GetPlotDistance(sx, sy, v:GetX(), v:GetY()) <= 1 then
    print("ERR|settler is covered by " .. info.UnitType .. " at " .. v:GetX() .. "," .. v:GetY())
  end
end
local nw = 0
for _, v in Players[0]:GetUnits():Members() do
  if GameInfo.Units[v:GetType()].UnitType == "UNIT_WARRIOR" then
    nw = nw + 1
    print("OK|expendable|" .. v:GetX() .. "," .. v:GetY() .. "|hp " .. (v:GetMaxDamage() - v:GetDamage()))
    if Map.GetPlotDistance(v:GetX(), v:GetY(), ax, ay) ~= 1 then print("ERR|warrior is not beside the attacker") end
    if Map.GetPlotDistance(v:GetX(), v:GetY(), sx, sy) < 2 then print("ERR|warrior covers the settler") end
  end
end
if nw ~= 1 then print("ERR|expected one own warrior, found " .. nw) end
